name: refuge-vo-1
text: This Mumbai tower has an empty floor. By law. No flats. No walls. Just columns and air. It's not unfinished. In Maharashtra, once a tower passes twenty-four metres, a refuge area comes on every seventh floor you live on. Here's why. In a fire, the stairs fill with smoke faster than people can get down. So you don't run thirty floors. You go down a few, step into open air... and wait for rescue. [excited] And the builder doesn't lose. Up to four percent of the floor area it serves is free of FSI. But it can never be sold. Never locked. Never turned into a flat. So that empty floor isn't missing. It's waiting.
